The Company tracks profitability through its 'Normalised PAT' framework, which is pegged to a normalised annual investment yield of 8% to provide a view of underlying profitability insulated from short-term mark-to-market volatility. The Company continued to strengthen its claims ecosystem through AI/ML-enabled analytics, network management, wellness interventions, teleconsultation and technology-led claims processing, with the objective of improving precision, efficiency and customer experience.
Digital remained a key lever for both growth and efficiency during the quarter. The Company's proprietary Digital D2C channel was the fastest-growing channel with 137% YoY growth in H1 FY27, led by younger customers, higher sum-insured levels and increased participation beyond Metro cities.
97% of fresh policies were sourced digitally, reflecting the depth of digital adoption across the Company's retail distribution franchise.
During the quarter, the Company upgraded its customer relationship management platform to Salesforce, sharpening lead management and conversion in D2C, and scaled up AI-powered bots across customer acquisition and service. More than half of active agents now use ATOM PRO, the Company's AI-enabled distribution platform. The Star Health Customer App exceeded 17 million downloads, with 1.5 million monthly active users. In claims, 96% of claims are now processed on the Company's new AI-enabled platform, with strengthened detection of fraud, waste and abuse.
Star Health's proprietary distribution continued to drive growth, with Agency and Digital D2C together contributing over 90% of GWP in H1 FY27. The Company added 39,000 agents during the half year, taking its agency force to 8.7 lakh, the largest among standalone health insurers, while agent productivity rose 19% YoY. 93% of fresh business came from customers buying health insurance for the first time, and non-metro geographies contributed over 65% of fresh business.

Commenting on the performance of the Company, Mr. Anand Roy, CEO & Managing Director, Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited, said:
"Our customers are at the heart of how we measure progress. This progress is reflected not only in our financial growth, but also in the confidence customers place in us and their experience when they need healthcare support. Persistency improved by 4% YoY to 102%, while our Company Net Promoter Score increased by 4 points to 65. These measures reinforce our focus on earning customer trust through simpler service, responsive support and a smoother claims experience. We are strengthening provider relationships and expanding wellness initiatives to support customers beyond claims, while investing in AI and digital capabilities to make access and service more seamless. Q2 FY27 marked our fifth successive quarter of improvement in underwriting results, and our first-half underwriting profit exceeded that of the entire previous year. This progress supports our commitment to building a resilient business that delivers lasting value for customers and shareholders."
